loadOrder.reason: SKSE iterates SKSE/Plugins/*.dll with FindFirstFile (skse64/PluginManager.cpp ScanPlugins) and loads in that order. NTFS FindFirstFile on this machine placed !PopupGuard.dll at position 0 against the 64 distinct installed plugin file names (0_PopupGuard.dll would be 1, PopupGuard.dll 43, _PopupGuard.dll 63 = last). MO2's virtual listing is name ordered too: skse64.log of the 2026-09-07 19:00 launch lists the 53 'checking plugin' lines in strict case-insensitive alphabetical order.
loadOrder.preload: Exports SKSEPlugin_Preload, so SKSE maps and calls it in its preinit hook (before the game's global initializers), ahead of every Load-phase plugin's DllMain. EngineFixes is the only other preload plugin installed and sorts after '!'.

attachTiming.reason: Under the loader lock the plugin touches only kernel32/ntdll (INI read via CreateFileW, GetProcAddress on already-mapped user32/kernel32, a static user32 import anchor guarantees mapping) and MinHook (private heap, VirtualAlloc, thread freeze via Toolhelp + Get/SetThreadContext). No shell32/COM, CRT file I/O, LoadLibrary or thread creation in DllMain. The Documents log needs SHGetKnownFolderPath, so it opens at the first SKSE entry point (SKSEPlugin_Preload, main thread, outside DllMain); attach-time lines are buffered (16 x 512 bytes) and flushed then. In SKSE's flow nothing runs between our LoadLibrary and our SKSEPlugin_Preload. The module pins itself at the first SKSE entry point so inline hooks never outlive their code; a plain LoadLibrary/FreeLibrary pair without SKSE (host tests) unhooks on detach.

funnelProbe.conclusion: W and ExW funnel into MessageBoxTimeoutW; the ANSI path goes through MessageBoxTimeoutA and the Indirect variants use an internal worker, so a single MessageBoxTimeoutW hook would not provably cover them. All exported entry points are hooked; the first hook answers without calling the original, so each call yields one record.

On the next launch verify PopupGuard.log shows the hook table plus 'preload phase' and 'load phase' lines, skse64.log lists 'checking plugin !PopupGuard.dll' first and 'preloading plugin "PopupGuard"' before EngineFixes, and the game reaches the main menu and loads a save.
limitations: Covers only calls that reach the hooked exported entry points inside the game process: not skse64_loader.exe or Windows Error Reporting dialogs (separate processes), not comctl32 TaskDialog or custom dialog windows, not hangs that never call MessageBox. Callers that branch on the answer receive IDOK even for MB_YESNO (flags are logged). Attribution names the nearest frame that pushed a return address; a tail-jumping wrapper is attributed to its caller. Lines raised before the log opens are buffered (16 x 512 bytes).
